name: Death Saving Throws
when: Whenever you start your turn with 0 Hit Points, you must make a Death Saving Throw.
roll: 1d20; 10 or higher succeeds, otherwise you fail. This save is not tied to an ability score.
resetWhen: The number of successes and failures is reset to zero when you regain any Hit Points or become Stable.
damageAtZeroHp: You suffer a Death Saving Throw failure. A Critical Hit causes two failures. If the damage equals or exceeds your Hit Point maximum, you die.
instantDeath: When damage reduces you to 0 Hit Points and there is damage remaining, you die if the remaining damage equals or exceeds your Hit Point maximum.
stabilize: You can take the Help action to try to stabilize a creature with 0 Hit Points, which requires a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check. A Stable creature doesn't make Death Saving Throws even though it has 0 Hit Points, but it still has the Unconscious condition. If the creature takes damage, it stops being Stable and starts making Death Saving Throws again.
knockOut: When you would reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack, you can instead reduce the creature to 1 Hit Point and give it the Unconscious condition.
